bioParagraphs: 苏云雷（Yunlei Su），非典型理工博士生，同时也是小宇宙播客《待会儿再说》节目主持人。目前就读于香港科技大学（广州）社会枢纽城市治理与设计学域（UGOD）Urban Morphology Studio；此前先后在安徽大学（地理信息科学）获本科学位、新加坡国立大学（NUS，应用地理信息系统）获理学硕士学位，并曾于工业界担任前端开发与项目经理及科研助理。
学术研究聚焦于 WebGIS、城市数字孪生（Urban Digital Twins）、人-建筑交互（Human-Building Interaction）、虚拟现实（VR）城市建模与眼动感知实验，以及结合街景与卫星多视角影像和多模态大语言模型的城市建筑精细化表征；研究之余热衷于独立全栈产品开发（如「阿薄 / BOJI」）与围绕 AI 和人生议题的播客对谈。
bioParagraphsEn: Yunlei Su is an unconventional STEM PhD student in the Thrust of Urban Governance and Design (UGOD), Urban Morphology Studio at The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou), and the host of the Xiaoyuzhou podcast "Talk Later" (《待会儿再说》). He previously earned his BSc in GIS from Anhui University and MSc in Applied GIS from the National University of Singapore (NUS), alongside industry experience in frontend engineering and project management.

His research centers on WebGIS, Urban Digital Twins, Human-Building Interaction (HBI), VR city modeling with eye-tracking perception, and multimodal LLM-driven urban building characterization. Outside research, he builds full-stack indie products (BOJI / 阿薄) and hosts unhurried conversations on AI and life.

researchInterests.title: Urban Digital Twins & Human-Centric Sensing
researchInterests.titleZh: 城市数字孪生与以人为本的感知计算
researchInterests.summary: 探索「人即传感器（Humans as Sensors）」理念在城市数字孪生中的应用，将个体行为与步行舒适度等社会感知数据接入物理–社会–虚拟融合的城市信息系统。
researchInterests.summaryEn: Integrating the "Humans as Sensors" paradigm into urban digital twins to bridge physical infrastructure, participatory human sensing, and virtual decision systems.

researchInterests.title: Human-Building Interaction & VR Perception
researchInterests.titleZh: 人-建筑交互与 VR 城市建模感知
researchInterests.summary: 结合沉浸式虚拟现实与眼动追踪技术，量化建筑立面与建成环境元素对人类注视行为的吸引机制，并提出感知驱动的三维城市模型 LOD 优化框架。
researchInterests.summaryEn: Combining immersive VR and eye-tracking experiments to measure human visual attention in built environments and formulate perception-driven 3D city LOD design.

researchInterests.title: Multimodal GeoAI & Street-View Analytics
researchInterests.titleZh: 多模态 GeoAI 与街景/多视角影像分析
researchInterests.summary: 融合街景影像、遥感影像与 OpenStreetMap 空间信息，利用微调多模态大语言模型（MLLM）自动提取多尺度建筑属性，并量化连续街景序列异质性对感知的影响。
researchInterests.summaryEn: Fusing street-view imagery, satellite observations, and OpenStreetMap via fine-tuned multimodal LLMs for multi-scale building characterization and sequential perception analysis.

researchInterests.title: WebGIS & Urban Spatial Dynamics
researchInterests.titleZh: WebGIS 系统与城市空间格局演替
researchInterests.summary: 基于 OpenLayers、Cesium、GeoServer 与空间统计模型构建生态与城市多源空间管理平台，定量分析快速城镇化区域的土地利用转移与驱动力机制。
researchInterests.summaryEn: Building multi-source 2D/3D WebGIS platforms with OpenLayers, CesiumJS, and GeoServer while quantifying rapid urban expansion patterns and socioeconomic drivers.
